title.en: Lower the heating while a window is open

description.en: Lowers the target temperature of a thermostat when a window or door stays open longer than a set time, and restores the previous temperature when it is closed again.
description.de: Senkt die Solltemperatur eines Thermostats ab, wenn ein Fenster oder eine Tür länger als eine eingestellte Zeit offen ist, und stellt die vorherige Temperatur wieder her, sobald es geschlossen wird.

author: GermanBluefox

title.en: Lower after the window is open for
title.de: Absenken, wenn das Fenster offen ist seit

blockly:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <variables>
    <variable id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</variable>
    <variable type="timeout" id="lowerTimer">lowerTimer</variable>
    <variable id="value">value</variable>
  </variables>
  <block type="on" x="10" y="10">
    <field name="OID">{{window.ACTUAL}}</field>
    <field name="CONDITION">ne</field>
    <field name="ACK_CONDITION"></field>
    <statement name="STATEMENT">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="on_source">
            <field name="ATTR">state.val</field>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="controls_if">
            <value name="IF0">
              <block type="logic_compare">
                <field name="OP">EQ</field>
                <value name="A">
                  <block type="variables_get">
                    <field name="VAR" id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
                <value name="B">
                  <block type="logic_null"></block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </value>
            <statement name="DO0">
              <block type="timeouts_cleartimeout">
                <field name="NAME">lowerTimer</field>
                <next>
                  <block type="timeouts_settimeout">
                    <field name="NAME">lowerTimer</field>
                    <field name="DELAY">{{delay}}</field>
                    <field name="UNIT">sec</field>
                    <statement name="STATEMENT">
                      <block type="get_value_async">
                        <field name="ATTR">val</field>
                        <field name="OID">{{thermostat.SET}}</field>
                        <statement name="STATEMENT">
                          <block type="variables_set">
                            <field name="VAR" id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</field>
                            <value name="VALUE">
                              <block type="variables_get">
                                <field name="VAR" id="value">value</field>
                              </block>
                            </value>
                            <next>
                              <block type="control">
                                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                                <field name="OID">{{thermostat.SET}}</field>
                                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                                <value name="VALUE">
                                  <block type="math_number">
                                    <field name="NUM">{{temperature}}</field>
                                  </block>
                                </value>
                              </block>
                            </next>
                          </block>
                        </statement>
                      </block>
                    </statement>
                  </block>
                </next>
              </block>
            </statement>
          </block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="timeouts_cleartimeout">
            <field name="NAME">lowerTimer</field>
            <next>
              <block type="controls_if">
                <value name="IF0">
                  <block type="logic_compare">
                    <field name="OP">NEQ</field>
                    <value name="A">
                      <block type="variables_get">
                        <field name="VAR" id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</field>
                      </block>
                    </value>
                    <value name="B">
                      <block type="logic_null"></block>
                    </value>
                  </block>
                </value>
                <statement name="DO0">
                  <block type="control">
                    <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                    <field name="OID">{{thermostat.SET}}</field>
                    <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                    <value name="VALUE">
                      <block type="variables_get">
                        <field name="VAR" id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</field>
                      </block>
                    </value>
                    <next>
                      <block type="variables_set">
                        <field name="VAR" id="savedTemperature">savedTemperature</field>
                        <value name="VALUE">
                          <block type="logic_null"></block>
                        </value>
                      </block>
                    </next>
                  </block>
                </statement>
              </block>
            </next>
          </block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>
